::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 155,851 people lived in County Wicklow, up 9.4% on 2016. It had the 11th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 124% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Wicklow was €1,730, the second highest of the 26 counties.
:::
